rationale: For an industrial field inspection tool used outdoors, high contrast and extreme legibility are paramount. A brutalist, technical, 'Swiss' approach removes decorative clutter, using strict grids and signal colors (Safety Orange, Green, Red) to guide the inspector's focus.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Technical Grid. Elements are separated by hard 1px borders rather than soft shadows.
layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles) to accommodate field usage.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-sm (2px) to maintain a robust, industrial feel.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders (border-zinc-200 or border-zinc-300) for separation.

pin_gate.layout: Centered viewport, heavy typography. The keypad should be a strict CSS grid (grid-cols-3) with large, stark square buttons (border border-zinc-200 bg-white hover:bg-zinc-100).
pin_gate.background_image: Use the scaffolding image with high opacity white overlay (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm) to keep it visible but unobtrusive.

header.style: Sticky top, bg-white, border-b border-zinc-200, z-50. Must include a prominent Live Clock in mono font (e.g., IBM Plex Mono if available, or just tight tracking sans) and App Title.

inspection_form.inputs: Shadcn standard inputs but customized: h-14, text-lg, border-zinc-300, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500. Labels must be uppercase 'labels' scale.
inspection_form.checklist_row: Flex-col on mobile, flex-row on larger screens. Question text is large and readable. PASS/FAIL/N/A should be a segmented control (flex row) where the active state uses the designated status color.
inspection_form.photo_upload: Dashed border area (border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-300 bg-zinc-50), min-h-[120px] flex items-center justify-center. Hover state: border-orange-500.
inspection_form.signature_pad: bg-zinc-50, border border-zinc-300. Must include an absolutely positioned 'Clear' text button (text-xs uppercase text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-500) inside the pad area.

archive_folders.accordion: Shadcn Accordion. Thick borders between items. Accordion trigger should display the Site Name prominently.
archive_folders.inspection_card: Grid layout inside the accordion content. Display Date, Inspector, ID, Thumbnail, and a highly visible Status Badge (Green/Red pill). Include a destructive Delete button.

buttons.primary: bg-orange-600 text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wide h-14 w-full rounded-sm hover:bg-orange-700 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-900 font-bold uppercase h-14 w-full rounded-sm hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors

media_urls.description: Architectural scaffolding to be used as a subtle background pattern behind the PIN gate.
Inspector in hard hat looking at tablet. Use for empty archive states or successful submission screen.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Instant color changes (duration-150), no bouncy scales. Keep it snappy.
motion_and_interactions.page_transition: Simple opacity fade. No massive transform animations.

icons.usage: Use strictly for functional communication (e.g., Camera for photo upload, Clock for time, Chevron for accordions). Do not use decoratively.

testing.rule: Every button, input, accordion, and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the font imports for Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans into index.css.
Apply 'font-sans' with IBM Plex Sans for the body and define a custom font family for Cabinet Grotesk for headings.
Build the application completely mobile-first, ensuring all touch targets (like the PASS/FAIL toggles and signature pad) are easily usable on a small screen.
Integrate Shadcn UI components but strip away soft rounded corners and drop-shadows. Replace them with hard borders (rounded-sm) according to the 'Technical Grid' philosophy.
Ensure the final tag status explicitly highlights RED or GREEN prominently before the submission button.
